newsitem.title: USA: Citizens Bancshares to acquire UniBank.
newsitem.headline: Citizens Bancshares to acquire UniBank.

text.p: Citizens Bancshares Inc said on Friday that it has agreed to acquire UniBank of Steubenville, Ohio, in a tax-free, stock-for-stock exchange.
Citizens said in a news release that UniBank is a $240 million bank with 12 locations in Jefferson and Columbiana counties.
Citizens did not provide an estimate of the financial value of the transaction, which is subject to a definitive agreement and approval by regulators and UniBank shareholders.
Citizens is a $1 billon bank holding company that also is the parent of Freedom Financial Life Insurance Co. The company's shares closed Thursday at 54 in Nasdaq trading.
